column1: # Where each town named in data/era-ground.tsv is, for ONE purpose: tools/build_era.py hands the point to the kit's erasnap.py, which REFUSES a place
# whose point falls inside a DIFFERENT region's ring than the one it was given, or within 15 km of its own region's ring edge unless a region across the
# edge carries the same label in that year (the rings are "approximate by design"). It decides nothing else: the region of a place is the row in
# data/era-ground.tsv, which was chosen from these points and the contract's rings.
# how: the source of the point. «archive gazetteer-local» and «kit gazetteer-overrides» are hand-set coordinates with their own reason in
# sources/gazetteer-local.json and the kit's data; «kit gazetteer cache» is the kit's shared Nominatim cache, exact matches only; «GeoNames (country,
# pop n)» is the Record Atlas's GeoNames gazetteer (read only), with the population of the place chosen; «hand» is written by hand to two decimals.
